notes: Technical report (arXiv 2409.17146), not a system card. No safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, privacy, or dangerous-capability section; zero hits for those terms in the text layer. The only 'hallucinations' mention (p.17) is a training-dropout hypothesis ('may reduce hallucinations'), not a model behavior test or claim, so hallucination is uncovered. Per pilot safety-only rule, evalResults is empty. Skipped all capability tables and scores: Table 1 (AI2D, ChartQA, VQA v2.0, DocVQA, InfoQA, TextVQA, RealWorldQA, MMMU, MathVista, CountBenchQA, PixMo-Count, Average, Elo), Tables 2–5 (model/data/counting ablations and human Elo), Table 9 (Chatbot Arena), Table 10 (clock reading), Table 11 (pointing), Tables 12–14 (high-res FT, text-only, AI2D opaque), plus appendix caption F1/precision-recall and further ablations. AndroidControl appears as fine-tuning data and a brief action demo, not a safety/autonomy eval. Seed checkpoints Molmo-7B-O and MolmoE-1B are covered because the report describes and evaluates them as Molmo family models.
